I will do this small rice plot mostly the way I know from before. The plot is only a quarter hectare, so I will not spend big money on it, but if I get a little fertilizer from the cooperative or share with a neighbor, I will put some because rice gives better when I do that. Since this land is mine, I will carry manure to it, use my own local seed, and my family will do the work. I will bring water to the plot, and I will not hire labor or buy pesticide.
